podcast.title: Singing Ability in The Partridge Family
podcast.body: When *The Partridge Family* sitcom was being cast, Shirley Jones, David Cassidy's real stepmother, was initially believed to be the only cast member who could sing, before producers discovered David Cassidy's vocal talents. "Their plan was just to dub in the music because as far as they knew, Shirley Jones was the only one the cast who knew how to sing."
